title: Among users who have posted comments with a score below 60 and also own at
question: Among users who have posted comments with a score below 60 and also own at least one post with more than 1000 views, find the display name of the one whose most valuable post (by FavoriteCount) has the highest favorite count.

prediction.sql:
SELECT u."XCL_055"
FROM users AS u
WHERE u."XCL_052" IN (
    SELECT c."XCL_010"
    FROM comments AS c
    WHERE c."XCL_007" < 60
)
AND u."XCL_052" IN (
    SELECT p."XCL_033"
    FROM posts AS p
    WHERE p."XCL_030" > 1000
)
ORDER BY (
    SELECT MAX(p2."XCL_039")
    FROM posts AS p2
    WHERE p2."XCL_033" = u."XCL_052"
) DESC
LIMIT 1
